home.description: When ``true``, perform an APT homing operation on startup.  Homing parks each axis at its end-stop (position 0).

invertJogAxes.description: Axis labels whose jog direction should be flipped; see **Movement model** below.

port.description: Serial port of the BSC203 controller.

travelRangeUm.description: Full travel per axis in µm (``8000`` for DRV208 8 mm actuators).  Absolute coordinates run ``0..travelRangeUm`` and every move is clamped to that range.
